selection_rules.selection_method: Per fold: sort state_id ascending (0..49). Select first 2 states satisfying ALL eligibility criteria. If fewer than 2 states eligible, select all eligible and record shortfall.
selection_rules.rationale: States are fixed per fold. All 6 conditions run on the SAME states. This controls for state-level variation across conditions.

clean_success.source: CLEAN1500 episode COMPLETE.json or Phase B held-out rollout

teacher_positive.definition: Episode has at least one valid corridor start (teacher_positive=true in held-out labels)

trace_complete.definition: All steps have valid 25D features, no NaN, no missing steps, step_idx contiguous from 0

target_valid.definition: Teacher target site is valid and found in MuJoCo (for teacher-eligible tasks)

detector_emits_on_at_least_one_seed.preference: PREFER states where >=2 of 3 detector seeds emit. But do NOT filter exclusively. Record emit pattern for all selected states.
detector_emits_on_at_least_one_seed.rationale: States with detector emission are more informative for VIS validation, but excluding no-emission states would bias the ITT analysis.

selection_procedure.step_1: For each fold, load HELDOUT_FEATURE_DATASET.csv and FOLDxx_heldout_episode_anchors.json
selection_procedure.step_2: For each state_id 0..49, check eligibility criteria
selection_procedure.step_4: Select first 2 eligible states per fold
selection_procedure.step_5: For each selected state, record: detector emit status per seed, teacher_anchor, corridor_active_steps, clean task_success, n_steps
selection_procedure.step_6: Write LOTO_VIS_STATE_SELECTION_V1.json with selected state_ids and all eligibility data
selection_procedure.step_7: Freeze. NO changes after this point.

caveats.clean_success_source: CLEAN1500 collection currently in progress (~89/1500). States without CLEAN1500 data may need dedicated clean rollouts. If CLEAN1500 data is incomplete for a fold's task, run a clean rollout with identical collector configuration.
caveats.state_id_only: Selected by state_id within the held-out task. Episodes come from Wave1 (s0-4) or Wave2 (s5-49) privileged corpus.
caveats.not_selected_by_vis_performance: Selection is purely by sort order + eligibility. VIS success is NOT a selection criterion.
